statement: Pinned Classic Controller subpage describes writable selector 0xA400FE defaulting to format 0x01. Its six-byte decoded extension report packs left stick axes as 6-bit, right stick axes and two analog trigger travel values as 5-bit, together with active-low button and digital full-press trigger flags. Buttons and analog trigger travel are separate semantics.

applicability.revision: WiiBrew pinned community documentation; no authenticated retail capture
applicability.scope: Classic Controller > Data Format 0x01. Source-only, not a physical acceptance result. Corroborates wii-gap-wiibrew-extension-data-format-selector; compare wii-c5-extension-packing.
